meta.title: Add Raspberry Pi 4 hardware acceleration support and debugging utilities
meta.body_summary: Add documentation, runtime warnings, and debugging utilities to guide Raspberry Pi 4 users to enable hardware video acceleration by removing bundled FFmpeg libraries, aiming to resolve playback lag.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added comprehensive Pi4 hardware acceleration docs and debug utils; maintainer closed with brief thanks but no merge, indicating mismatch in desired scope or approach.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 428 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium addition by absolute volume. As a feature-enabling performance PR, it was closed without merge, perhaps because the maintainer considered the added detection and documentation unnecessary or misaligned.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer wang-bin closed the PR with 'thanks but sorry', providing no explicit technical feedback or request for changes.
review_details.performance_claim: Enabling hardware acceleration on Raspberry Pi 4 will resolve video playback lag for 1080p and 720p videos by using GPU decoding instead of software decoding.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed with 'thanks but sorry' without requesting changes or providing a reason.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent added a significant amount of documentation and runtime detection code to guide Pi4 hardware acceleration, but the maintainer rejected the approach entirely without asking for revision, indicating a lack of alignment with the desired solution scope or implementation style.

detection_detail.code_reading: No code-reading review details available; maintainer rejection without specific feedback.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides no benchmark or profiling data, only narrative performance claims based on user reports.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-PR cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added RPi4 detection and hardware acceleration warning logic in video_player_mdk.dart, controller methods in controller.dart, documentation in README.md, debug tab in example app main.dart, and a test in player_test.dart.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation, example app debug interface, and test are supplementary; main detection logic and warnings are in video_player_mdk.dart.
change_trajectory: Single substantive commit adding all Pi4 detection, warnings, docs, and debug utilities.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer closed the PR with 'thanks but sorry', offering no specific technical feedback.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with comprehensive Pi4 hardware acceleration docs and detection utilities, linked to issue #276.
About 2.6 hours later, maintainer wang-bin closed the PR with a brief 'thanks but sorry', without requesting changes.
